# prusa-profiles@c712aaf177 PrusaResearch/2.5.12.ini [printer:Prusa CORE One HF0.4 nozzle] end_gcode
# (the INI's \n escapes are expanded; these two header lines are stripped by the test)
{if layer_z < max_print_height}G1 Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+1, max_print_height)} F720 ; Move print head up{endif}
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M141 S0 ; disable chamber control
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X242 Y211 F10200 ; park
G4 ; wait
M572 S0 ; reset PA
M84 X Y E ; disable motors
; max_layer_z = [max_layer_z]
